name: Trailing-12 operating statement
what: Income and expenses for the 12 months ending on a date, the starting point for underwriting NOI.

fields.label: Period end
fields.definition: The last day of the 12 months covered.

fields.label: Gross potential rent
fields.definition: Rent if every space were leased at the current rent roll.

fields.label: Vacancy and credit loss
fields.definition: Rent not collected because of vacancy or nonpayment.

fields.label: Expense recoveries
fields.definition: Operating expenses billed back to tenants.

fields.label: Other income
fields.definition: Income other than rent and recoveries.

fields.label: Effective gross income
fields.definition: Gross potential rent, less vacancy and credit loss, plus recoveries and other income.

fields.label: Operating expenses
fields.definition: Taxes, insurance, utilities, repairs, management and other costs of operating the property.

fields.label: Net operating income
fields.definition: Effective gross income less operating expenses, before debt service and capital spending.

fields.label: Capital expenditures
fields.definition: Spending on long-lived improvements, kept below the NOI line.
